signature.name: VTask.trans
signature.type: {X : Type u} -> {Y : Type v} -> [TopologicalSpace X] -> [TopologicalSpace Y] -> {f₀ f₁ f₂ : C(X, Y)} -> (F : f₀.Homotopy f₁) -> (G : f₁.Homotopy f₂) -> f₀.Homotopy f₂

conventions.statement: For t ≤ 1/2 the output is F evaluated at rescaled time 2t; for t > 1/2 the output is G evaluated at rescaled time 2t - 1.
conventions.note: This piecewise rescaling doubles the speed of each homotopy so each occupies exactly half the unit interval.

conventions.statement: At t = 1/2 both branches yield f₁(x), so the concatenated map is continuous across the seam.
conventions.note: This relies on the boundary conditions F(1,x) = f₁(x) and G(0,x) = f₁(x).

conventions.statement: At t = 0 the concatenated homotopy equals f₀, inherited from F's left boundary condition.
conventions.note: Follows from the rescaling: 2·0 = 0 and F(0,x) = f₀(x).

conventions.statement: At t = 1 the concatenated homotopy equals f₂, inherited from G's right boundary condition.
conventions.note: Follows from the rescaling: 2·1 - 1 = 1 and G(1,x) = f₂(x).

facts.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f₀ f₁ f₂ : C(X, Y)} (F : f₀.Homotopy f₁) (G : f₁.Homotopy f₂) (x : X), VTask.trans F G (0, x) = f₀ x

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f₀ f₁ f₂ : C(X, Y)} (F : f₀.Homotopy f₁) (G : f₁.Homotopy f₂) (x : X), VTask.trans F G (1, x) = f₂ x

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {X : Type*} {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f₀ f₁ f₂ : C(X, Y)} (F : f₀.Homotopy f₁) (G : f₁.Homotopy f₂), Continuous (VTask.trans F G)
